div.div: مَشَى مُتَبَازِخًا He (a man) walked like an old woman affecting, or constraining herself, to erect her backbone, so that the part between her shoulders recedes: (A:) or, like an old woman having her posteriors prominent, and the upper part of her back, next the neck, bent. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
